sections.Profile:
"Cue-Tease" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in July 1963. Designed by Ted Zale, the game features a billiards theme, incorporating two flippers, four pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, three standup targets, and two rollunder lanes.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
